{{Quote|For your main course, you will have a selection of either Velossian caramachi shell-backs in white suvoli cream, or roasted Hillindor game fowl in brestel nuts with zinchari spice.|434-FPC|<ref name="Galladinium">''[[Galladinium's Fantastic Technology]]''</ref>}}
The '''Velossian caramachi shell-back''' was a type of creature<ref name="Galladinium" /> that originated in<ref name="Planetnamia" /> the [[Velossia system/Legends|Velossia system]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim's]] [[Manda sector/Legends|Manda sector]].<ref name="EAOC" /> At some point by [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Galladinium's Fantastic Technology]]'' is set during the [[Time/Legends|time]] period between the events of {{Film|IV}} and {{Film|V}}, which corresponds to some point between [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] and [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], according to ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref> the [[434-FPC Personal Chef Droid]] [[434-FPC]] [[Chef/Legends|cooked]] a [[Foodstuff/Legends|meal]] for several people. For the main [[Diet/Legends|course]], the [[Cooking droid/Legends|droid]] had prepared a selection of either Velossian caramachi shell-backs prepared in [[white suvoli cream]] or roasted [[Hillindor game fowl]] served in [[brestel nut]]s along with [[zinchari spice]].<ref name="Galladinium" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Velossian caramachi shell-back was mentioned in ''[[Galladinium's Fantastic Technology]]'', a [[1995]] sourcebook authored by [[Rick D. Stuart]] for use with [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="Galladinium" />
